policy.palace: Permanent loci carry durable evolutionary identities, causal relationships, population-level mechanisms, spatial comparisons, evidence structures, and teacher-required terms that benefit from stable retrieval locations.
policy.prerequisite_reactivation: Prior-unit concepts are reactivated inside the relevant Unit 7 locus and are not given duplicate standalone palaces.
policy.challenge_lab: Hardy-Weinberg calculations, graph interpretation, scenario classification, evidence synthesis, cladogram construction, FRQ reasoning, and other transfer procedures remain outside permanent loci.
policy.scope_guard: Scope guards remain non-runtime constraints that shape later wording and QA; they are never memorization targets.
policy.review: Every exact-name palace-managed record is eligible for delayed Review after story exposure. Review should test scientific role and meaning before optional sound support.
policy.spelling: No Unit 7 item receives a mandatory spelling gate at F2. Adaptive spelling support may be added later when useful.
